 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. CD Tenerife have issued a statement confirming the condition of player Jesús de Miguel , who was involved in a heavy collision with Andorra FC goalkeeper JesúsOwono during yesterday's match between the two sides.
 "Jesús de Miguel's neurological condition has deteriorated. Further information will be provided in the coming hours," reads the medical update released by the Canary Islands club following Monday's incident.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Jesús de Miguel had to be carried off the pitch on a stretcher and intubated after a heavy blow from the Andorran team's goalkeeper.
 The player, who was in cardiorespiratory arrest for nearly 20 minutes, had to receive cardiopulmonary resuscitation on the way to the hospital where he is being treated
 The club will provide further details throughout Monday
